questions.question: Which theme should the app use by default?

options.label: Light
options.description: A bright background with dark text. Reads well in daylight and matches most system defaults.

options.label: Dark
options.description: A dark background with light text. Easier on the eyes at night and in low-light rooms.

questions.question: Which features should the app include?

options.label: Search
options.description: Full-text search across the user's content, with filters and recent-query history.

options.label: Export
options.description: Download content in portable formats such as CSV, JSON, or PDF.
